title: Mario Tennis Aces
subtitle: A rally with another resource to manage
summary: Mario Tennis Aces is Camelot's Switch tennis game, released on 22 June 2018.
body: Mario Tennis Aces is Camelot's Switch tennis game, released on 22 June 2018. Mario and a broad cast compete through familiar strokes and more elaborate special techniques, turning a rally into a contest over positioning, timing and energy. Topspin, slices and lobs still define how the ball crosses the court, but a powerful opportunity can threaten the opponent's racket as well as the point. The player has to read both the direction of the next shot and the resources available for responding to it.

Zone Shots allow precise targeting and can damage a defending racket unless the return is timed correctly. Repeated damage breaks it, with losing the last available racket ending the match. Zone Speed slows the surrounding action to help reach a distant ball, but spends the same energy used by other advanced techniques. Rallies and Trick Shots replenish that supply. A strong response therefore carries a cost, giving the player reasons to save energy, attempt a difficult block or use a safer stroke that keeps the exchange alive.

The character roster offers different combinations of reach, speed and power, with further competitors added through post-release tournaments and updates. An adventure mode places the mechanics within a sequence of special challenges, while multiplayer provides the continuing test of reading another person's choices. Motoi Sakuraba composed the music. Aces develops Mario Tennis around a useful tension: the expressive special moves create spectacular moments, but the next ordinary return can still determine whether the energy needed for another advantage will be available.
